description: Whether a prompt fits each model's context window, with remaining tokens after an output reserve. Give tokens, or text to count with o200k_base. Omit model to check all listed models. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.
